extDescription.message: Silent receipt and label printing for web applications such as the Koha ILS, through the Olorin Companion App running on this computer.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension store and manager.

popupCheckingTitle.description: Popup card title while the connection check runs.

popupCheckingText.description: Popup card text while the connection check runs.

popupConnectedTitle.description: Popup card title when the companion app is reachable.

popupConnectedText.description: Popup card text when the companion app is reachable.

popupVersionPrefix.description: Prefix shown before the companion app version number, e.g. 'v2.1.0'.

popupNotConnectedTitle.description: Popup card title when the companion app is not reachable.

popupNotConnectedText.message: Please check if the Companion App is running.
popupNotConnectedText.description: Popup card text when the companion app is not reachable.

popupPermissionTitle.description: Popup card title when host permissions are missing (Firefox).

popupPermissionText.message: Olorin needs access to your library pages to find print buttons.
popupPermissionText.description: Popup card text when host permissions are missing (Firefox).

popupGrantAccess.description: Button that requests the missing host permissions.

popupSettings.description: Button that opens the options page.

optionsTitle.description: Browser tab title of the options page.

optionsHeading.description: Main heading of the options page.

optionsRefreshPrinters.description: Button that re-fetches the OS printer list from the companion app.

optionsErrorBanner.message: Companion App not reachable — make sure it is running, then click Refresh Printers.
optionsErrorBanner.description: Error banner shown when the companion app does not answer.

optionsColPageWidth.description: Column header: page width in inches.

optionsColPageHeight.description: Column header: page height in inches.

optionsColPrinterOption.description: Column header: the OS printer mapped to the logical printer.

optionsColMargin.description: Column header spanning the four margin fields.

optionsColCopies.description: Column header: number of copies to print.

optionsPrinterReceipt.description: Row label for the receipt_printer logical printer.

optionsPrinterSticker.description: Row label for the sticker_printer logical printer.

optionsPrinterPaper.description: Row label for the paper_printer logical printer.

optionsPrinterFullSheet.description: Row label for the full_sheet_printer logical printer.

optionsPrinterLabel.description: Row label for the label_printer logical printer.

optionsSelect.description: Placeholder option of the printer and orientation dropdowns.

optionsOrientationPortrait.description: Orientation dropdown label (the stored value stays 'Portrait').

optionsOrientationLandscape.description: Orientation dropdown label (the stored value stays 'Landscape').

optionsOrientationAutomatic.description: Orientation dropdown label (the stored value stays 'Automatic').

optionsDuplexOff.description: Duplex dropdown label for single-sided printing (stored value is empty).

optionsDuplexLong.description: Duplex dropdown label (the stored value stays 'long').

optionsDuplexShort.description: Duplex dropdown label (the stored value stays 'short').

optionsWidthPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the page width inputs, in inches.

optionsHeightPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the page height inputs, in inches.

optionsMarginPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the margin inputs, in inches.

optionsCopiesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the copies inputs — blank means one copy.

optionsSave.description: Button that saves the printer settings.

optionsSavedToast.description: Toast shown after the settings were saved.
